Create ONE complete finished macOS application icon for Harumachi: Next Summer, a Japanese small-town life game about returning to grandmother's town and reviving the summer festival. Drawn anime materials with a few carefully placed lines, never photorealistic, never an oil painting, never a 3D render, never a glossy UI button. A bold simple silhouette that is recognizable at 32px. One dominant subject, generous breathing space, tightly limited palette, no fine clutter. Subject: a large traditional round vermilion-and-ivory Japanese paper lantern with a very simple red goldfish emblem on the ivory paper. Chestnut wooden rims, not shiny metal. Make it flatter and more boldly graphic than a painted 3D lantern, with precise anime paper-rib lines and at most two tiny gold spark shapes.
